c: The CMDB Health card has no scores on pdi2: its jobs haven't run.
say: The CMDB health card has no scores on pdi2, because its jobs are switched off. Turn them on to get scores.

c: A CI is stale after 60 days without an update.
say: A CI counts as stale after sixty days without an update.

c: De-duplication Tasks list CIs found twice; remediate them in the CMDB Workspace.
say: De-duplication tasks list CIs found twice. Remediate them from the CMDB workspace.

c: The Data Manager has only the Dependent CI policies.
say: The data manager has only the dependent CI policies. No attestation, retirement or certification policy is set up.
